_instructions: Copy to config/authorization-manifest.json (Git-ignored), fill in every field, then set authorization.approved to true. The harness refuses to run otherwise. Never put passwords, MFA codes or tokens in this file.

authorization.escalationContact: Who to contact at Appifest if testing causes a problem (name/role only)

target._allowedHostsNote: Top-level navigation to any other host (for example a payment or SSO page) is stopped and recorded. Add an SSO host only if your login really goes through one.
target.buildIdentifierHint: Optional: where a version/build number is shown on the site, e.g. footer text
target._buildIdentifierNote: Regex searched in the page text to record the EQUITAS build/version, if shown. Script asset names are also fingerprinted to detect a deployment during a run.
target._signedInStartNote: Where signed-in scenarios begin: 'post-sign-in' (the page EQUITAS showed after you signed in) or 'root'.

accounts.actualEntitlement: as shown in Settings — fill in
accounts.notes: Using the founder account for investigator personas does NOT show how other entitlements behave. Results are labelled with this account's real role.
accounts._approvedForNote: Remove any scenario you do not approve. Not listed on purpose: P17-subscriber (needs a server-side NEW account) P19-funder (needs a funder-role account) and K-permission-boundary (needs a non-admin account). Every run under this account is labelled founder_admin; it does not show how other entitlements behave. npm run check-manifest rejects IDs that do not exist in config/scenarios.json.
accounts._expectPlanScreenNote: Regression check for the plan defect: false means this account should go straight into the product (or see a clear Continue). probe-plan --assert fails otherwise.

permittedWorkflows._selectFreePlanNote: Selecting even a free plan changes account state. Leave false unless you approve it for a specific dedicated test account.

syntheticData.allowedContentNote: Only the synthetic tasks in config/scenarios.json. No PHI, unpublished data, confidential grants or review material.

testerAi._note: The blinded user agent and the provisional scientific judge call the Anthropic API from YOUR computer. Redacted page text (no screenshots) is sent. Set approved to false to run only deterministic probes.

evidence._redactTermsNote: List words to remove from all evidence and tester-AI input: your name, institution, account display names. Kept only in this Git-ignored file.

_prohibitedNote: Each pattern matches at the start of a word in the control's real name/text ('pay' matches 'payment' but not 'display'). A match stops the scenario as CONSEQUENTIAL_ACTION_STOP.

authVerification._note: Optional. Leave the lists empty to use the markers you pick during `npm run login`. A marker is {"role":"button","name":"Account menu"} (exact accessible name) or {"text":"Founder dashboard"}. Signed-in markers must NOT appear when signed out; login checks this.

publicAudit._note: Signed-out public website audit. All values optional; these are the defaults. Protected routes (sign-in, app, admin, account, billing, API …) are never requested; every non-GET request is blocked.
